resources.string: Location management shows current values, with bold customized settings and more compact controls.
Mark objects as favorites in Observatory, then use the catalogue heart to show only favorites.
Favorite checkboxes use a pink accent. Filter counts adapt to favorites, search and other active filters.
New selections become the active object while the list stays in place until you return to the main view.
Location files can include selected objects. Automatic exports share position, altitude and time zone while date and time remain live.
Object data refresh automatically when needed. The open filter panel stays visible while you browse.
